observations.interpretation: Supports inherited managed cultivation in Bali before the starting date; does not establish whole-island adoption hectares or an annual yield.
Small cooperative systems do not justify a blanket assumption of centralized hydraulic state organization. Management scores must allow local collective maintenance.
Abang flood destruction and later reconstruction are dated resilience/progression evidence, not starting infrastructure magnitudes.

exclusions: Thesis explicitly identifies missing direct information between twelfth and nineteenth centuries.
Medieval tambuku and related extent terms cannot be converted into hectares from this source.
Modern or colonial subak hectare totals must not be retrojected to 1337.
No capacity or cultivated-area increase adopted from this source alone.
